description: Tinylawn is an AI receptionist and answering service for landscaping, lawn care, pest control, and other outdoor service businesses. Connect Tinylawn to ChatGPT to review recent calls and saved summaries, understand what callers needed, identify follow-up opportunities, and use call context in conversations or workflows with other enabled tools. Tinylawn provides details and links from the organization you authorize; messages, scheduling, and other actions are handled by the separate tools you choose.

defaultPrompt: Turn my 10 most recent calls into a prioritized follow-up plan
